$comment: KaspaRocket launch of the token ZKASB on testnet-10 (kasparocket.fun, read from api-tn10.kaspa.org on 2026-10-14): the token genesis, the creator's move of the whole supply into the launch's LP_AMM pool (covenant-id custody, owner scheme 4), the pool's own genesis and the first buy from the pool. Inputs carry their spent outputs (`entry`); lock time, gas and sequences are 0. crates/kob-tests/tests/program_kasparockettoken11458.rs rebuilds the transactions (their ids), reproduces the token inputs' signature scripts with KOB's builder and runs them in the engine.
